LibFuzzer harness for fd_ssarchive_parse_filename with fd_boot setup and cleanup.

# Purpose
This file is a libFuzzer harness for `fd_ssarchive_parse_filename`. [`LLVMFuzzerInitialize`](<#llvmfuzzerinitialize>) prepares the `fd` runtime, disables log backtraces with `FD_LOG_BACKTRACE=0`, sets log levels, and registers `fd_halt` with `atexit`. [`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>) copies the fuzz input into a null-terminated string, then calls `fd_ssarchive_parse_filename` to test filename parsing with the input data. The file also checks that `FD_HAS_HOSTED` is enabled before it can build.
